text:
kat: heads-up  orion-lite onboarding looks fine on recall@10 against our general holdout (0.88) but clustering/silhouette is way worse vs atlas-v3 and we have a spike in false-positive NN matches for some topical anchors.

infra-bot: deployed orion-lite-int8pc -> staging canary 12%. view: https://console.redwood.ai/staging/models/orion-lite

jorge: ran quick eval (k=10) on 5k anchors:
```text
Recall@10 orion-lite: 0.88
Recall@10 atlas-v3: 0.90
FP-rate@10 (orion-lite): 0.14
FP-rate@10 (atlas-v3): 0.06
Silhouette mean orion-lite: 0.21
Silhouette mean atlas-v3: 0.45
```

priya: curious — embedding norm var is higher on orion-lite. summary:
```text
mean_norms: orion 6.1, atlas 4.7
std_norms: orion 2.4, atlas 1.1
```

alina: that smells like missing whitening / post-processor mismatch. our production pipeline applies a small-centering + PCA-whiten for atlas variants. did we forget to enable it for orion-lite?

kat: checking deploy config now. devex-bot can flip postproc flags w/o redeploy?

devex-bot: yes. example:
```bash
redwood postproc set --model orion-lite --whiten true --center true --env staging
```

kat: flipped whitening+centering for orion-lite staging slice (applied only to int8_pc variant). re-ran the 5k batch.

jorge: new numbers after whitening:
```text
Recall@10 orion-lite (whitened): 0.89
FP-rate@10: 0.07
Silhouette mean: 0.43
mean_norms: 4.8, std_norms:1.2
```

priya: great recovery. latency impact negligible. next steps: 1) ensure onboarding checklist includes postproc parity, 2) add silhouette check to model-onboard baseline (fail if silhouette delta > 0.15), 3) run multilingual anchor FP scan (ES/FR/JA).

kat: I'll open ticket RED-3782 with commands, eval artifacts, and a small python snippet to apply whitening used in infra. will schedule 20m sync tomorrow to review the lang scans. thanks all :thumbsup:
